positive_triggers: Propose a journal update from today's lesson and my practice answers.
Review my recent notes and summarize demonstrated strengths and review needs.
Prepare my learning history so another agent can resume after I pull the repository.
negative_triggers: Teach me a concept without recording anything.
Reorganize my existing course repository and move its files.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: I have no journal yet. From today's session, I completed two exercises but needed hints on both. Please record my progress for future sessions.
pass_criteria: Asks whether the learner wants a journal and agrees on its location before creating one.
Does not equate completing exercises with independent mastery; records the hints as relevant evidence.
Proposes concise, reviewable content and preserves uncertainty rather than inventing progress history.
Does not commit or push journal data.
